subject: Next steps and rotating demo windows for Skylark Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Cho <natalie.cho@skylarkhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps and rotating demo windows for Skylark Health

Hi Natalie — great conversation this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Primary goals: validate latency/cost for inference on sensitive PHI flows, confirm VPC/private deployment path, and scope a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with engineering.
- Open items: data retention requirements, SOC2 evidence owners, and a sample traffic profile you can share (tokens/sec typical).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Schedule the technical deep dive (60–90m) with your engineering leads + our infra/reliability folks.
2) Run a short pre-demo checklist so we hit the right configs (quantization profile, KV cache expectations).
3) Propose a rotating demo window cadence so we can accommodate US/EU/APAC stakeholders without making one region always early/late.

To make scheduling straightforward I attached a working availability grid (skylark_availability_grid.xlsx) with your slots filled from today’s notes. Could you and Carlos mark 3 preferred windows (one per region preference) — we’ll convert these into a repeating rotation that swaps every week to keep it fair.

If helpful, here are three starter rotation options we can lock in after you confirm availability:
- Option A (weekly rotation): Week 1 — US morning (10:00–11:30 PT), Week 2 — EU afternoon (15:00–16:30 CET), Week 3 — APAC evening (18:00–19:30 JST)
- Option B (bi-weekly pairs): Week 1/2 — US & EU split (two shorter blocks), Week 3/4 — APAC heavy
- Option C (fixed tri-band): three 45m blocks staggered across three days, rotates responsibility for follow-up notes

Please reply with the three preferred windows (or upload edits to the sheet). Once you confirm I’ll loop in our infra lead (Rishi) and schedule the deep dive.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

--
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: skylark_availability_grid.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Natalie Cho <natalie.cho@skylarkhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@skylarkhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 17:04:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Next steps and rotating demo windows for Skylark Health

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear recap. Carlos and I reviewed the availability grid. High level constraints from our side:

- EU team (me + infra) prefers 14:00–16:00 CET but can stretch to 17:00 if needed
- US product team prefers 10:00–12:00 PT
- APAC (engineering lead in SG) is only available 07:30–09:30 SGT or after 19:00 SGT on weekdays

I’ve made notes in skylark_availability_grid.xlsx with three candidate windows (one per region). Two quick asks: can Redwood commit to having an infra engineer and an ops person on the deep dive, and can we get a short pre-demo checklist to confirm the sample traffic format?

If those are ok we’re happy to try the weekly rotation idea (Option A) so no single region is always on odd hours.

—Natalie
Natalie Cho
Head of Infrastructure, Skylark Health
natalie.cho@skylarkhealth.com

Thanks for the notes, Natalie — that helps. Rishi and Laura, flagging for capacity + ops alignment.

Based on Natalie’s constraints I converted the three candidate windows into a concrete weekly rotation (attached as proposed-rotation-summary.pdf) so the team can visualize how times shift. Summary:

- Week 1 (US-focused): Tue 10:00–11:30 PT (UTC-7) — target for US product + Redwood infra
- Week 2 (EU-focused): Wed 15:00–16:30 CET (UTC+1) — target for EU infra + product
- Week 3 (APAC-focused): Thu 18:30–19:30 SGT (UTC+8) — concise deep dive for APAC engineering (45–60m)

Rotation notes:
- Each week we keep a consistent owner on the Skylark side for follow-ups (Natalie/Carlos rotate)
- Redwood will include one infra engineer (Rishi) and one ops engineer (Soojin) on each session
- If a given week’s window conflicts for core stakeholders we’ll shift a single occurrence and document the swap in the shared Drive link

If that looks acceptable I’ll:
1) Publish a recurring calendar series and send invites for the first three instances
2) Share a one‑page pre-demo checklist (sample payload format + required access)
3) Confirm the attendees list for the deep dive (please add any additional Skylark engineers to the sheet)

Attachments: proposed-rotation-summary.pdf (pdf); skylark_availability_grid.xlsx (spreadsheet)

--

LGTM from infra. We can staff the three-week rotation as proposed. A few operational clarifications before I join the first session:

- Proposed fixed windows in UTC (to avoid DST confusion):
  - US window: 17:00–18:30 UTC (10:00–11:30 PT)
  - EU window: 14:00–15:30 UTC (15:00–16:30 CET)
  - APAC window: 10:30–11:30 UTC (18:30–19:30 SGT)

- Pre-demo checklist: Marcus, happy to own the infra section (I’ll drop the checklist doc in the Drive link).

Marcus — if you can publish the invites I’ll confirm the infra attendees and load the sample config into a staging endpoint for the call.

Thanks — Rishi
